audit.why: 53.42% Emerald+ over 1097 games matches the Vex-favoured framing.
Even-to-favoured poke lane gated by Rebuttal windows — correct; Mel is immobile so Vex's anti-dash passive matters less here, which the page mostly respects.
Spikes (3-5, 6, Luden's/Malignance, late) are coherent and each references the Rebuttal window.

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[0] and early call Vex's poke 'point-and-click' — Vex Q is a 1200-range skillshot projectile, and both Q and R's missile are reflected by Rebuttal, which the page should say explicitly.
audit.why: Kit: Vex Q/R carry the projectile flag; Rebuttal reflects projectiles. Vex W's pulse is not a projectile.
audit.corrected: whys[0] and early rewritten; cooldowns field now names Rebuttal's 38s rank-1 cooldown.

audit.why: Rebuttal is 38/35/33/29/26 — the longest, most punishable cooldown in the lane.

audit.whatIsWrong: Mel called he/his across 18 fields; two copy-paste bleed bullets; dontsFull[1].d warns about 'the next dash' against a dashless enemy.
audit.why: Lint MISGENDER and COPY_PASTE_BLEED; Mel has no dash in her kit.
audit.corrected: All flagged fields rewritten with she/her; bleed bullets replaced; dash wording re-grounded on her E root engage.

audit.why: Missing interactions (Overwhelm execute threshold, Rebuttal absorbing burst, P auto-reset tell) folded into rewritten fields where they fit the length band.

edits.before: His combo is a sprint through your fear field — mark the approach and his engage spell arrives pre-interrupted.
edits.after: Her whole kill plan is projectiles and a reflect — poke when Rebuttal is dark and her Overwhelm stacks never reach the number.

edits.before: E-mark the contact, Q through the marked line for the fear, auto, walk — every trade he answers with a dash just schedules the next fear.
edits.after: E the zone, Q through it with the fear glow, auto, walk — all while Rebuttal is down, so nothing you fired comes back with interest.

edits.before: Ahead, gloom harder: zone Mel with marked-rotation threat, R every skirmish his team starts, and reset through the kills — fed Vex makes mobility a typo.
edits.after: Ahead, gloom harder: zone Mel off the wave with Q threat, R every skirmish her team starts, and reset through the kills — fed Vex deletes an immobile mage.

edits.before: Full kit: E-mark into Q-fear is your trade engine — every passive proc is crowd control he scheduled for you.
edits.after: Full kit: E-Gloom into Q-fear is your trade engine, and she has no dash to escape the slow zone once rooted in it.

edits.before: Mark and bolt — your trades are honest and your passive makes his mobility dishonest. Bank Gloom procs like currency.
edits.after: Gloom and bolt — she wants calm farm to stack Overwhelm; tax every last-hit while her 38s Rebuttal is dark and deny the stacks.

edits.before: Best wave: an E-Q cleared push that crashes with Doom glowing — your shove doubles as a fear-loaded threat display. Worst wave: a frozen wave near his tower with W down and no glow — the anti-dive mage with no anti or dive left. Crash timing: every crash should buy something — a reset, a plate, a roam. Autopilot shoving buys ganks.
edits.after: Best wave: an E-Q cleared push that crashes with Doom glowing — your shove doubles as a fear-loaded threat display. Worst wave: a frozen wave near her tower with W down and no glow — the anti-dive mage with no anti or dive left. Crash timing: every crash should buy something — a reset, a plate, a roam. edits.before: - Mel Rebuttal: matchup-defining — Reflects your projectiles back — never poke while it glows. Count it out loud if you must. - Your W Personal Space has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Rebuttal is 38s at rank 1, 26s max — it reflects your Q and R missiles, so never fire while it glows; once spent, you own a 30s poke window. - Her E root cycles every 11-9s. - Your W has one job: the moment it all goes wrong.

edits.before: Good trade: E-mark the contact, Q through the marked line for the fear, auto, walk — every trade he answers with a dash just schedules the next fear. Bad trade: Spending the W pulse on poke spacing and then eating the real engage unfeared — the pulse is the matchup against everything that moves fast.
edits.after: Good trade: E the zone, Q through it with the fear glow, auto, walk — all while Rebuttal is down, so nothing you fired comes back with interest. Bad trade: throwing the loaded Q or R missile into an active Rebuttal — she reflects it back and banks Overwhelm off the trade you gifted her.
